core.subject: Fault Line Map -- agreement and contention visualization across domain recommendations
objects: {{AGREEMENT_POINTS}} -- findings where most or all domains concur
{{CONTENTION_POINTS}} -- where and why domain recommendations diverge, with domains on each side
{{UNRESOLVED_TENSIONS}} -- analytical tensions that cannot be resolved with current information
{{PRE_MORTEM_FINDINGS}} -- failure modes identified in Phase 4.5 pre-mortem challenge (Tier 3 only)
notes: {{CONTENTION_DRIVERS}} -- underlying assumption or priority differences driving each disagreement
{{FACTUAL_VS_VALUES}} -- whether each contention is factual (resolvable with data) or values-based (judgment call)
constraints: All text must be legible at 6.5 inch print width
No decorative elements -- every visual element conveys data

data.pre_mortem_count: {{PRE_MORTEM_COUNT}} -- number of pre-mortem failure modes (0 if Tier 2)
